title: cad2d-ir artifact freshness and residual pydwg candidate screen
mode: primary-source repository, package metadata, and source review
scope: Revalidate the artifact identity of the already-listed cad2d-ir 2D route
Screen one residual standalone DWG parser candidate
Separate parser lineage from downstream IR, conversion, projection, and consumer behavior
Assess whether either route supplies 3D, ACIS/AcDs, or independent semantic evidence
Define a bounded optional comparison protocol without expanding routine validation

sources.name: cad2d-ir 0.13.0 PyPI page and artifact metadata
sources.observed: PyPI lists version 0.13.0, released 2026-10-18, with alpha classifier. The source distribution SHA-256 is 4ec2ffb5986fd3ec20e9d6f972feaebc420b282a9acdf61a52b0eb06a2f4607d. The documented IR has a bounded common-2D entity set, separates modelspace and paper-space layouts, provides a built-in DXF parser and R12/AC1009 and R2010/AC1024 export, and discloses export loss/approximation through structured diagnostics and an entity-to-handle map. The documented surface does not claim 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY, ACIS, or general 3D semantics. The artifact was not downloaded or run.

sources.name: cad2d-ir DWG adapter and mutable project metadata
sources.observed: The DWG importer calls ezdwg.read(), uses ezdwg.raw for selected tables, computes the source file SHA-256, records conversion/skip/approximation counters, and projects owner/layout information into a typed 2D IR. The optional DWG dependency is ezdwg>=0.11,<1. PyPI identifies the latest package as 0.13.0, while the reviewed mutable raw main pyproject reports 0.10.6; an immutable repository commit or release binding for the exact package artifact was not established. Attribute DWG behavior to the ezdwg parser lineage, not to an independent DWG implementation.

sources.name: mghohoo/pydwg README and parser entry point
sources.observed: The README calls the project an initial version and discloses memory-management issues. It documents R18/R21 as targets and R24/R27 as TODO. The parser rejects signatures outside R18/R21 even though its enum recognizes later signatures. The inspected route is metadata/forensics oriented; no broad entity denominator, DXF or DWG writer, ACIS route, or 3D semantic evidence was found.

assessment.planImpact: Refreshes the existing cad2d-ir optional 2D DXF candidate with its latest PyPI version and sdist digest while recording that mutable main metadata is still version 0.10.6, so source/package identity remains unresolved. Its DWG leg stays under ezdwg lineage. Screens mghohoo/pydwg out as an early R18/R21 metadata parser. Neither route enters normal validation or changes 3D/ACIS evidence gates.

method.limitations: GitHub main/master content is mutable and the cad2d-ir package/source version discrepancy remains unresolved. The source distribution hash is recorded for a future exact-artifact check but was not fetched, installed, or executed. The findings are route-admission guidance, not runtime qualification or support evidence.
